main_window.title: Showrunner
appearance.base.primary.help: Buttons that go ahead, checkboxes and selected rows.
appearance.base.secondary.help: Links, the focus ring, selected text and drop targets.
appearance.import_failed: This file isn't a Showrunner theme.
appearance.import_skipped: Theme imported. {count} entries could not be read and were skipped.
appearance.export_failed: The theme could not be saved: {error}
dependencies.intro: Showrunner uses these programs when they are present. A missing one turns off only the features listed under it.
dependencies.forget_tip: Forget the location you chose and search again.
dependencies.busy.resolving: Looking up the newest release of {name}…
dependencies.confirm_download: Download {name} {version} ({size}) from {host} and install it into Showrunner's tools folder?
dependencies.confirm_download_unknown: Download {name} {version} from {host} and install it into Showrunner's tools folder?
dependencies.confirm_installer: {name} ships as an installer. Download {name} {version} ({size}) from {host}? You will be asked before the installer starts.
dependencies.start_installer: The {name} installer is downloaded and verified. Start it now? Windows may ask for permission.
dependencies.installer_started: The installer is running. Click Check again when it has finished.
dependencies.installer_kept: The installer was not started. It is kept at {path}.
feature.edit_properties: editing track names, flags and titles
library.tip.unsure: More than one subtitle file fits this video. Check the pairing.
sheet.tracks_failed: The tracks could not be read: {reason}
sheet.tracks_not_read: The tracks have not been read.
sheet.placeholder: Select an episode, a movie, a season or a show.
sheet.kind.subtitle: Subtitles {count}
sheet.tracks.name: Name
sheet.chapters.name: Name
details.identity.title: Title
details.unsure.one: One more file also fits this video. The closest name was paired; check that it is the right one.
details.unsure.other: {count} more files also fit this video. The closest name was paired; check that it is the right one.
status.cancelled: Cancelled. The videos that were reached were added.
status.load_failed: The folder could not be read: {error}
empty.title: Drop a folder to start
loading.title: Reading the library
empty.lead: A show, a season, a movie or a whole library. Showrunner reads every video's tracks, chapters and attachments, and pairs the subtitle files next to them.
empty.example.show.label: A show
empty.example.episodes.label: Episodes in one folder
empty.example.movies.label: Movies
empty.example.subtitles.label: Subtitles
empty.example.subtitles.hint: , beside the video or in a Subs folder
empty.missing: {name} was not found. Without it these are off: {features}.
settings.save_failed: The profile could not be saved: {error}
settings.save_as_failed: The profile {name} could not be saved: {error}
settings.default_read_only: Default is built in. Save your changes as a new profile.
settings.footer.unsaved: Changes to {name} are not saved yet. Preview already uses them.
settings.title: Settings
settings.folder_note: Settings and profiles are kept in your app data folder.
settings.appearance.lead: Colors and light or dark mode. Saved as soon as you change them.
settings.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
settings.unsaved.text: {name} has changes that are not saved. Save them first?
settings.general.lead: How Showrunner starts. Saved as soon as you change it.
settings.general.reopen_help: The folders that were open, the selection and the pane sizes. The folders are read again, so the window shows what is on disk now.
settings.general.empty_help: Drop a folder or choose one to begin.
settings.general.large_note: A large library takes a while to read. The loading page shows the count, and Cancel there opens the empty window instead.
settings.general.from_window: From the window as it is now.
settings.profiles.lead: A profile is a saved set of stage options. The active one is used for Preview and Apply.
settings.profiles.delete_confirm: Delete the profile {name}? Its file goes away.
settings.profiles.default_note: Default is built in. Changes made while it is active are saved with Save as.
settings.profiles.active_note: Used for Preview and Apply in the main window, and edited on the pages under it.
settings.profiles.no_file: Built in: it has no file and cannot be changed.
settings.naming.lead: The MKV title and the track names the Metadata stage writes. Source is set for this batch, not saved in the profile.
settings.naming.preview_on: Preview on {name}, selected in the main window.
settings.naming.preview_sample: No file is selected in the main window, so the previews use a sample episode.
settings.naming.title: Title
settings.naming.title_help: The MKV title, one per file.
settings.naming.subtitle: Subtitle tracks
settings.naming.kind_track.subtitle: subtitles {id}
settings.naming.insert_hint: Double-click or press Enter to insert at the cursor of the template you were editing.
settings.naming.group_hint: [ ] leaves its text out when a token inside it is empty. {{season:00}} pads a number with zeros.
settings.naming.escape_hint: To write a brace or bracket itself, put a backslash before it: \{{ \}} \[ \].
settings.naming.custom_help: A constant is fixed text, a composite is a template of other tokens, a pattern is the first group of a regular expression searched in the file name.
settings.naming.col.name: Name
settings.naming.footer_problems.one: 1 problem in Naming. Metadata is not planned until it is fixed.
settings.naming.footer_problems.other: {count} problems in Naming. Metadata is not planned until they are fixed.
problem.bad_format: Padding {detail} works only on a number token, and only with zeros.
problem.unexpected_close_brace: A closing brace without an opening one. Write \}} for the character itself.
problem.unexpected_close_group: A closing bracket without an opening one. Write \] for the character itself.
problem.trailing_escape: A backslash at the end escapes nothing.
problem.pattern_without_group: A pattern needs a group in parentheses: its text is the value.
problem.shadows_builtin: {detail} is a built-in token; the built-in one is used.
problem.invalid_name: A token name uses lower case letters, digits and underscores.
problem.duplicate_name: {detail} is defined twice; the first one is used.
problem.empty_channel_range: The low end is above the high end, so no track fits.
problem.fits_every_track: This rule tests nothing, so it fits every track.
settings.tracks.lead: Which tracks stay, and which get the default and forced flags. The first switched-on rule that keeps or drops a track decides it; a track no rule decides is kept.
settings.tracks.flags_from_names_help: A track named Commentary, SDH or Forced counts as one, since many files name such tracks without setting the flag.
settings.tracks.label: Label
settings.tracks.kind.subtitle: Subtitles
settings.tracks.languages_placeholder: Any language, for example tur, eng
settings.tracks.languages_help: Use und for a track with no language.
settings.tracks.codecs_placeholder: Any codec, for example AAC, E-AC-3, DTS
settings.tracks.name: Name
settings.tracks.shape.first: First kept track of each kind this rule matches
settings.tracks.footer_problems: Rule {rules} has a problem. Tracks is not planned until it is fixed.
settings.tracks.result.title: Result on {name}
settings.tracks.result.note: the file selected in the main window
settings.tracks.result.no_selection: Select a file in the main window to see what the rules do to it.
settings.tracks.result.needs_remux: Needs a remux: tracks are dropped or a subtitle file is added, so a stage that writes a new file must carry it out.
settings.tracks.result.header_only: Header edit only: no remux needed.
settings.tracks.result.no_change: The rules change nothing on this file.
settings.tracks.result.refused: No plan for this file: the rules would leave {what}. Apply leaves its tracks as they are.
settings.tracks.result.rule_problem: Rule {rules} has a problem: the broken part fits no track, so the result shows what the rule does now.
jobs.title: Unfinished job
jobs.unfinished: An earlier Apply with the profile {profile} stopped after {done} of {total} steps. Resume it now? Each file is checked again first.
jobs.unresumable: An earlier Apply stopped after {done} of {total} steps, and this version of Showrunner cannot read it back. Forget it? Preview again to apply the files it did not reach.
stage.blocked_tip.one: Not planned: its options have 1 problem.
stage.blocked_tip.other: Not planned: its options have {count} problems.
stage.missing_program_tip: Needs {name}. Settings > Programs can download it.
stage.menu.language_label: A language code such as tr or pt-BR; empty leaves such tracks alone.
preview.apply_tip_stale: Preview again to apply the current options.
preview.confirm_remux.one: 1 is remuxed to a new file and its original goes to the Recycle Bin.
preview.confirm_remux.other: {count} are remuxed to new files and their originals go to the Recycle Bin.
preview.applied: Applied: {done} steps done, {failed} failed, {stale} skipped because the file changed.
preview.cancelled: Apply was cancelled. The steps that finished stay done; Preview again for the rest.
plan.title: Planned changes
plan.out_of_date: Options changed since the preview. Preview again to see what Apply would do now.
plan.kind.subtitle: subtitles
plan.needs_remux_nothing: Needs a remux, and Mux is off or MKVToolNix is missing: nothing on this file is written.
plan.unwritten: Nothing writes these flags: Metadata is off, or MKVToolNix is missing.
plan.tracks_refused: No plan for this file: the rules would leave {what} ({reasons}). Apply leaves its tracks as they are.
plan.not_planned_rules: Not planned for any file: rule {rules} has a problem.
plan.not_planned_naming.one: Not planned for any file: Naming has 1 problem.
plan.not_planned_naming.other: Not planned for any file: Naming has {count} problems.
plan.metadata.ids-not-from-mkvmerge: the tracks were read without MKVToolNix, so their numbers cannot be edited
plan.metadata.not-matroska: a {detail} file, and only Matroska headers can be edited in place
plan.metadata_waits: {text} Written by the remux this file needs.
plan.missing: The file could not be read: {error}
